            --accent-purple: #b47cff;

            --border: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
            --border-accent: rgba(0, 217, 163, 0.3);

            --font-display: 'Archivo Black', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'Space Mono', monospace;

            /* Clamp sizes from viewport-base.css */
            --title-size: clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.25rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.125rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.875rem);
            --slide-padding: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.25rem, 1vw, 1rem);

            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --duration-normal: 0.6s;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BASE RESET
           =========================================== */
        *, *::before, *::after {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT FITTING: MANDATORY BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           REVEAL ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(calc(-1 * clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px)));
            transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-blue));
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.4s var(--ease-out-expo);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAVIGATION DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
            z-index: 1000;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
            padding: 0;
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent-glow);
            transform: scale(1.5);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE NUMBERING
           =========================================== */
        .slide-num {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.75rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            left: var(--slide-padding);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 90%, rgba(0, 217, 163, 0.08) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 10%, rgba(77, 166, 255, 0.07) 0%, transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .title-slide .grid-bg {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px) clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px);
            mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, transparent 20%, black 90%);
        }

        .title-slide .slide-content {
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding-top: clamp(2rem, 6vh, 5rem);
            padding-bottom: clamp(2rem, 6vh, 5rem);
        }

        .source-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-radius: 100px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .source-badge::before {
            content: '';
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent);
            animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.4; }
        }

        .title-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .title-main {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5.5vw, 4.5rem);
            line-height: 1.05;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: 16ch;
        }

        .title-main em {
            font-style: normal;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .title-subtitle {
            font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.8vw, 1.2rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 55ch;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-top: clamp(0.75rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .meta-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 4px;
        }

        .meta-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        .meta-value {
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.4vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .meta-divider {
            width: 1px;
            height: 2.5em;
            background: var(--border);
        }

        /* Three headline stats */
        .stat-trio {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            max-width: min(90vw, 900px);
        }

        .stat-box {
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem) clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
        }

        .stat-box .num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .stat-box .label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SHARED DATA SLIDE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        .data-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 100%, rgba(77, 166, 255, 0.05) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .slide-header {
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.4rem);
        }

        .slide-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .slide-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            line-height: 1.1;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .slide-title em {
            font-style: normal;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .slide-title .red { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .slide-title .yellow { color: var(--accent-yellow); }
        .slide-title .blue { color: var(--accent-blue); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: INTELLIGENCE — BAR CHART TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .intel-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            align-items: start;
            max-height: min(72vh, 600px);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .rank-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1.1vw, 0.85rem);
        }

        .rank-table thead tr {
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
        }

        .rank-table thead th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: calc(var(--small-size) * 0.9);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            padding: 4px 6px;
            text-align: left;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .rank-table tbody tr {
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            transition: background 0.15s ease;
        }

        .rank-table tbody tr:hover {
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
        }

        .rank-table tbody tr.top-row td { color: var(--text-primary); }
        .rank-table tbody tr.ow-row td .badge-ow { color: var(--accent-yellow); }

        .rank-table td {
            padding: clamp(3px, 0.6vh, 8px) 6px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            vertical-align: middle;
        }

        .rank-table td.rank {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: 0.75em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            width: 1.8em;
        }

        .rank-table td.model-name {
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .rank-table td.provider {
            font-size: 0.85em;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .rank-table td.score {
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .bar-container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .bar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(4px, 0.6vh, 8px);
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            border-radius: 100px;
            overflow: hidden;
            min-width: 40px;
        }

        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 100px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-blue));
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
            width: 0;
        }

        .slide.visible .bar-fill {
            /* width set inline */
        }

        .score-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: 0.8em;
            font-weight: 700;
            min-width: 2em;
            text-align: right;
        }

        .score-top { color: var(--accent); }
        .score-mid { color: var(--text-secondary); }
        .score-low { color: var(--text-muted); }

        .intel-callout {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .callout-card {
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
        }

        .callout-card.yellow { border-left-color: var(--accent-yellow); }
        .callout-card.blue { border-left-color: var(--accent-blue); }

        .callout-headline {
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .callout-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: SPEED — HORIZONTAL BAR CHART
           =========================================== */
        .speed-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: start;
            overflow: hidden;
            max-height: min(72vh, 600px);
        }

        .speed-bar-list {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.8vh, 10px);
        }

        .speed-item {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(80px, 14vw, 160px) 1fr clamp(30px, 4vw, 50px);
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .speed-model {
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .speed-bar-track {
            height: clamp(6px, 1vh, 14px);
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            border-radius: 100px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .speed-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 100px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 1.1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .speed-bar-fill.fast { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), #00ffcc); }
        .speed-bar-fill.mid  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), #7ec8ff); }
        .speed-bar-fill.slow { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-purple), #d4a8ff); }

        .speed-tps {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.9vw, 0.75rem);
            text-align: right;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .speed-insight-list {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .speed-insight {
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.9rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1.1vw, 0.85rem);
            line-height: 1.5;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .speed-insight strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .speed-insight .val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: PRICING
           =========================================== */
        .pricing-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: start;
            overflow: hidden;
            max-height: min(72vh, 600px);
        }

        .price-list {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(3px, 0.7vh, 8px);
        }

        .price-item {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(75px, 12vw, 150px) 1fr clamp(40px, 5vw, 70px);
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .price-model {
            font-size: clamp(0.58rem, 0.95vw, 0.78rem);
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .price-bar-track {
            height: clamp(6px, 1vh, 14px);
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            border-radius: 100px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .price-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 100px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 1.1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .price-bar-fill.cheap  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), #00ffcc); }
        .price-bar-fill.mid    { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-yellow), #ffdf80); }
        .price-bar-fill.pricey { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-red), #ff8080); }

        .price-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.9vw, 0.75rem);
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .price-insights {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .price-highlight {
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.3rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        .price-highlight .big-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
            line-height: 1;
            color: var(--accent-red);
        }

        .price-highlight .big-label {
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .price-note {
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.85rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-yellow);
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            font-size: clamp(0.62rem, 1vw, 0.82rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .price-note strong { color: var(--text-primary); display: block; margin-bottom: 3px; }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: TRADE-OFFS
           =========================================== */
        .tradeoffs-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            align-items: start;
            overflow: hidden;
            max-height: min(73vh, 620px);
        }

        .scatter-wrapper {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .scatter-caption {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-style: italic;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .scatter-img {
            width: 100%;
            max-height: min(46vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .tradeoffs-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .summary-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: clamp(0.58rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .summary-table thead tr {
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
        }

        .summary-table thead th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: calc(var(--small-size) * 0.88);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.07em;
            padding: 5px 6px;
            text-align: left;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .summary-table thead th.right { text-align: right; }

        .summary-table tbody tr {
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
        }

        .summary-table td {
            padding: clamp(4px, 0.7vh, 8px) 6px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            vertical-align: middle;
        }

        .summary-table td.metric { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); }
        .summary-table td.right { text-align: right; }

                    <td style="width:clamp(60px,10vw,120px)">
                        <div class="bar-container">
                            <div class="bar-track">
                                <div class="bar-fill" data-width="${pct}%" style="width:0"></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="score ${scoreClass}">${row.score}</td>
                `;
                tbody.appendChild(tr);
            });
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BUILD SPEED BAR LIST
           =========================================== */
        function buildSpeedBars() {
            const list = document.getElementById('speedBarList');
            const maxTps = 218;
            SPEED_DATA.forEach(row => {
                const pct = Math.round((row.tps / maxTps) * 100);
                const li = document.createElement('li');
                li.className = 'speed-item';
                li.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="speed-model">${row.model}</span>
                    <div class="speed-bar-track">
                        <div class="speed-bar-fill ${row.type}" data-width="${pct}%" style="width:0"></div>
                    </div>
                    <span class="speed-tps">${row.tps}</span>
                `;
                list.appendChild(li);
            });
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BUILD PRICING BAR LIST
           =========================================== */
        function buildPricingBars() {
            const list = document.getElementById('pricingBarList');
            const maxPrice = 10.00;
            PRICE_DATA.forEach(row => {
                const pct = Math.round((row.price / maxPrice) * 100);
                const displayPrice = row.price < 1 ? `$${row.price.toFixed(2)}` : `$${row.price.toFixed(2)}`;
                const li = document.createElement('li');
                li.className = 'price-item';
                li.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="price-model">${row.model}</span>
                    <div class="price-bar-track">
                        <div class="price-bar-fill ${row.tier}" data-width="${pct}%" style="width:0"></div>
                    </div>
                    <span class="price-val">${displayPrice}</span>
                `;
                list.appendChild(li);
            });
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupMouseWheel();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.updateProgress(0);
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateProgress(idx);
                            this.updateNavDots(idx);
                            // Trigger bar animations
                            this.animateBars(entry.target);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.6 });

                this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
            }

            animateBars(slideEl) {
                const fills = slideEl.querySelectorAll('[data-width]');
                // Small delay to let the reveal animation start first
                setTimeout(() => {
                    fills.forEach((el, i) => {
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            el.style.width = el.getAttribute('data-width');
                        }, i * 30);
                    });
                }, 200);
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowRight', 'Space', 'PageDown'].includes(e.code)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowLeft', 'PageUp'].includes(e.code)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        this.goToSlide(diff > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupMouseWheel() {
                let wheelTimeout = null;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (wheelTimeout) return;
                    this.goToSlide(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
                    wheelTimeout = setTimeout(() => { wheelTimeout = null; }, 800);
                }, { passive: false });
            }

            goToSlide(idx) {
                const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, this.slides.length - 1));
                if (target === this.currentSlide) return;
                this.slides[target].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = target;
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    nav.appendChild(btn);
                });
            }

            updateNavDots(idx) {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
            }

            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = this.slides.length > 1 ? (idx / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100 : 100;
                document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = pct + '%';
            }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           INIT
           =========================================== */
        buildIntelTable();
        buildSpeedBars();
        buildPricingBars();
        new SlidePresentation();

        // Trigger first slide visibility immediately
        document.querySelector('.slide').classList.add('visible');
        document.querySelector('.slide').querySelectorAll('[data-width]').forEach((el, i) => {
            setTimeout(() => { el.style.width = el.getAttribute('data-width'); }, 300 + i * 30);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>AI Model Landscape April 2026</title>

    <!-- Fonts: Archivo Black for display, Space Grotesk for body -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo+Black&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <style>
        /* ===========================================
           CSS CUSTOM PROPERTIES (THEME)
           Data-forward dark theme with sharp accent
           =========================================== */
        :root {
            --bg-primary: #0b0e14;
            --bg-secondary: #111827;
            --bg-card: #161d2b;
            --bg-highlight: #1c2537;

            --text-primary: #e8edf5;
            --text-secondary: #7d8fa8;
            --text-muted: #4a5568;

            --accent: #00d9a3;
            --accent-dim: rgba(0, 217, 163, 0.15);
            --accent-glow: rgba(0, 217, 163, 0.4);
            --accent-red: #f54e4e;
            --accent-yellow: #f5c842;
            --accent-blue: #4da6ff;
            --accent-purple: #b47cff;

            --border: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
            --border-accent: rgba(0, 217, 163, 0.3);

            --font-display: 'Archivo Black', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'Space Mono', monospace;

            /* Clamp sizes from viewport-base.css */
            --title-size: clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.25rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.125rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.875rem);
            --slide-padding: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.25rem, 1vw, 1rem);

            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --duration-normal: 0.6s;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BASE RESET
           =========================================== */
        *, *::before, *::after {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT FITTING: MANDATORY BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           REVEAL ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(calc(-1 * clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px)));
            transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-blue));
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.4s var(--ease-out-expo);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAVIGATION DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
            z-index: 1000;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
            padding: 0;
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent-glow);
            transform: scale(1.5);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE NUMBERING
           =========================================== */
        .slide-num {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.75rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            left: var(--slide-padding);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 90%, rgba(0, 217, 163, 0.08) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 10%, rgba(77, 166, 255, 0.07) 0%, transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .title-slide .grid-bg {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px) clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px);
            mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, transparent 20%, black 90%);
        }

        .title-slide .slide-content {
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding-top: clamp(2rem, 6vh, 5rem);
            padding-bottom: clamp(2rem, 6vh, 5rem);
        }

        .source-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-radius: 100px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .source-badge::before {
            content: '';
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent);
            animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.4; }
        }

        .title-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .title-main {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5.5vw, 4.5rem);
            line-height: 1.05;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: 16ch;
        }

        .title-main em {
            font-style: normal;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .title-subtitle {
            font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.8vw, 1.2rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 55ch;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-top: clamp(0.75rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .meta-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 4px;
        }

        .meta-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        .meta-value {
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.4vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .meta-divider {
            width: 1px;
            height: 2.5em;
            background: var(--border);
        }

        /* Three headline stats */
        .stat-trio {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            max-width: min(90vw, 900px);
        }

        .stat-box {
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem) clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
        }

        .stat-box .num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .stat-box .label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SHARED DATA SLIDE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        .data-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 100%, rgba(77, 166, 255, 0.05) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .slide-header {
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.4rem);
        }

        .slide-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .slide-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            line-height: 1.1;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .slide-title em {
            font-style: normal;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .slide-title .red { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .slide-title .yellow { color: var(--accent-yellow); }
        .slide-title .blue { color: var(--accent-blue); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: INTELLIGENCE — BAR CHART TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .intel-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            align-items: start;
            max-height: min(72vh, 600px);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .rank-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1.1vw, 0.85rem);
        }

        .rank-table thead tr {
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
        }

        .rank-table thead th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: calc(var(--small-size) * 0.9);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            padding: 4px 6px;
            text-align: left;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .rank-table tbody tr {
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            transition: background 0.15s ease;
        }

        .rank-table tbody tr:hover {
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
        }

        .rank-table tbody tr.top-row td { color: var(--text-primary); }
        .rank-table tbody tr.ow-row td .badge-ow { color: var(--accent-yellow); }

        .rank-table td {
            padding: clamp(3px, 0.6vh, 8px) 6px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            vertical-align: middle;
        }

        .rank-table td.rank {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: 0.75em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            width: 1.8em;
        }

        .rank-table td.model-name {
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .rank-table td.provider {
            font-size: 0.85em;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .rank-table td.score {
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .bar-container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .bar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(4px, 0.6vh, 8px);
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            border-radius: 100px;
            overflow: hidden;
            min-width: 40px;
        }

        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 100px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-blue));
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
            width: 0;
        }

        .slide.visible .bar-fill {
            /* width set inline */
        }

        .score-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: 0.8em;
            font-weight: 700;
            min-width: 2em;
            text-align: right;
        }

        .score-top { color: var(--accent); }
        .score-mid { color: var(--text-secondary); }
        .score-low { color: var(--text-muted); }

        .intel-callout {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .callout-card {
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
        }

        .callout-card.yellow { border-left-color: var(--accent-yellow); }
        .callout-card.blue { border-left-color: var(--accent-blue); }

        .callout-headline {
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .callout-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: SPEED — HORIZONTAL BAR CHART
           =========================================== */
        .speed-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: start;
            overflow: hidden;
            max-height: min(72vh, 600px);
        }

        .speed-bar-list {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.8vh, 10px);
        }

        .speed-item {
            display: grid;

            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);

        .finding-icon.red    { background: rgba(245,78,78,0.12); color: var(--accent-red); }
        .finding-icon.yellow { background: rgba(245,200,66,0.15); color: var(--accent-yellow); }
        .finding-icon.blue   { background: rgba(77,166,255,0.15); color: var(--accent-blue); }
        .finding-icon.purple { background: rgba(180,124,255,0.15); color: var(--accent-purple); }

            font-size: clamp(0.72rem, 1.2vw, 0.92rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);

            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.55;

            grid-column: 1 / -1;

            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-radius: 10px;
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);

        }

        .reco-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            white-space: nowrap;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .reco-body {
            font-size: clamp(0.68rem, 1.15vw, 0.88rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.55;

        .reco-body strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           BUILD INTELLIGENCE TABLE

        function buildIntelTable() {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('intelTableBody');
            const maxScore = 57;
            INTEL_DATA.forEach(row => {
                const pct = Math.round((row.score / maxScore) * 100);
                const scoreClass = row.score >= 55 ? 'score-top' : (row.score >= 45 ? 'score-mid' : 'score-low');
                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                if (row.score >= 52) tr.classList.add('top-row');
                if (row.type === 'ow') tr.classList.add('ow-row');
                tr.innerHTML = `
                    <td class="rank">${row.rank}</td>

        /* ===========================================
           BUILD SPEED BAR LIST
           =========================================== */
        function buildSpeedBars() {
            const list = document.getElementById('speedBarList');
            const maxTps = 218;
            SPEED_DATA.forEach(row => {
                const pct = Math.round((row.tps / maxTps) * 100);
                const li = document.createElement('li');

           BUILD PRICING BAR LIST
           =========================================== */
        function buildPricingBars() {
            const list = document.getElementById('pricingBarList');
            const maxPrice = 10.00;
            PRICE_DATA.forEach(row => {
                const pct = Math.round((row.price / maxPrice) * 100);
                const displayPrice = row.price < 1 ? `$${row.price.toFixed(2)}` : `$${row.price.toFixed(2)}`;
                const li = document.createElement('li');
                li.className = 'price-item';
                li.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="price-model">${row.model}</span>
                    <div class="price-bar-track">
                        <div class="price-bar-fill ${row.tier}" data-width="${pct}%" style="width:0"></div>
                    </div>
                    <span class="price-val">${displayPrice}</span>
                `;
                list.appendChild(li);
            });
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupMouseWheel();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.updateProgress(0);
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateProgress(idx);
                            this.updateNavDots(idx);
                            // Trigger bar animations
                            this.animateBars(entry.target);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.6 });

                this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
            }

            animateBars(slideEl) {
                const fills = slideEl.querySelectorAll('[data-width]');
                // Small delay to let the reveal animation start first
                setTimeout(() => {
                    fills.forEach((el, i) => {
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            el.style.width = el.getAttribute('data-width');
                        }, i * 30);
                    });
                }, 200);
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowRight', 'Space', 'PageDown'].includes(e.code)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowLeft', 'PageUp'].includes(e.code)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        this.goToSlide(diff > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupMouseWheel() {
                let wheelTimeout = null;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (wheelTimeout) return;
                    this.goToSlide(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
                    wheelTimeout = setTimeout(() => { wheelTimeout = null; }, 800);
                }, { passive: false });
            }

            goToSlide(idx) {
                const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, this.slides.length - 1));
                if (target === this.currentSlide) return;
                this.slides[target].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = target;
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    nav.appendChild(btn);
                });
            }

            updateNavDots(idx) {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
            }

            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = this.slides.length > 1 ? (idx / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100 : 100;
                document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = pct + '%';
            }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           INIT
           =========================================== */
        buildIntelTable();
        buildSpeedBars();
        buildPricingBars();
        new SlidePresentation();

        // Trigger first slide visibility immediately
        document.querySelector('.slide').classList.add('visible');
        document.querySelector('.slide').querySelectorAll('[data-width]').forEach((el, i) => {
            setTimeout(() => { el.style.width = el.getAttribute('data-width'); }, 300 + i * 30);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .meta-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 4px;
        }

        .meta-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        .meta-value {
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.4vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .meta-divider {
            width: 1px;
            height: 2.5em;
            background: var(--border);
        }

        /* Three headline stats */
        .stat-trio {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            max-width: min(90vw, 900px);
        }

        .stat-box {
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem) clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
        }

        .stat-box .num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .stat-box .label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SHARED DATA SLIDE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        .data-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 100%, rgba(77, 166, 255, 0.05) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .slide-header {
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.4rem);
        }

        .slide-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .slide-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            line-height: 1.1;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .slide-title em {
            font-style: normal;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .slide-title .red { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .slide-title .yellow { color: var(--accent-yellow); }
        .slide-title .blue { color: var(--accent-blue); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: INTELLIGENCE — BAR CHART TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .intel-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            align-items: start;
            max-height: min(72vh, 600px);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .rank-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1.1vw, 0.85rem);
        }

        .rank-table thead tr {
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
        }

        .rank-table thead th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: calc(var(--small-size) * 0.9);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            padding: 4px 6px;
            text-align: left;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .rank-table tbody tr {
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            transition: background 0.15s ease;
        }

        .rank-table tbody tr:hover {
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
        }

        .rank-table tbody tr.top-row td { color: var(--text-primary); }
        .rank-table tbody tr.ow-row td .badge-ow { color: var(--accent-yellow); }

        .rank-table td {
            padding: clamp(3px, 0.6vh, 8px) 6px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            vertical-align: middle;
        }

        .rank-table td.rank {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: 0.75em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            width: 1.8em;
        }

        .rank-table td.model-name {
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .rank-table td.provider {
            font-size: 0.85em;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .rank-table td.score {
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .bar-container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .bar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(4px, 0.6vh, 8px);
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            border-radius: 100px;
            overflow: hidden;
            min-width: 40px;
        }

        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 100px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-blue));
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
            width: 0;
        }

        .slide.visible .bar-fill {
            /* width set inline */
        }

        .score-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: 0.8em;
            font-weight: 700;
            min-width: 2em;
            text-align: right;
        }

        .score-top { color: var(--accent); }
        .score-mid { color: var(--text-secondary); }
        .score-low { color: var(--text-muted); }

        .intel-callout {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .callout-card {
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
        }

        .callout-card.yellow { border-left-color: var(--accent-yellow); }
        .callout-card.blue { border-left-color: var(--accent-blue); }

        .callout-headline {
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .callout-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: SPEED — HORIZONTAL BAR CHART
           =========================================== */
        .speed-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: start;
            overflow: hidden;
            max-height: min(72vh, 600px);
        }

        .speed-bar-list {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.8vh, 10px);
        }

        .speed-item {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(80px, 14vw, 160px) 1fr clamp(30px, 4vw, 50px);
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .speed-model {
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .speed-bar-track {
            height: clamp(6px, 1vh, 14px);
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            border-radius: 100px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .speed-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 100px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 1.1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .speed-bar-fill.fast { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), #00ffcc); }
        .speed-bar-fill.mid  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), #7ec8ff); }
        .speed-bar-fill.slow { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-purple), #d4a8ff); }

        .speed-tps {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.9vw, 0.75rem);
            text-align: right;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .speed-insight-list {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .speed-insight {
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.9rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1.1vw, 0.85rem);
            line-height: 1.5;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .speed-insight strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .speed-insight .val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: PRICING
           =========================================== */
        .pricing-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: start;
            overflow: hidden;
            max-height: min(72vh, 600px);
        }

        .price-list {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(3px, 0.7vh, 8px);
        }

        .price-item {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(75px, 12vw, 150px) 1fr clamp(40px, 5vw, 70px);
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .price-model {
            font-size: clamp(0.58rem, 0.95vw, 0.78rem);
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .price-bar-track {
            height: clamp(6px, 1vh, 14px);
            background: var(--bg-highlight);
            border-radius: 100px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .price-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 100px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 1.1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .price-bar-fill.cheap  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), #00ffcc); }
        .price-bar-fill.mid    { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-yellow), #ffdf80); }
        .price-bar-fill.pricey { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-red), #ff8080); }

        .price-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.9vw, 0.75rem);
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .price-insights {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .price-highlight {
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.3rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        .price-highlight .big-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
            line-height: 1;
            color: var(--accent-red);
        }

        .price-highlight .big-label {
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .price-note {
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.85rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-yellow);
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            font-size: clamp(0.62rem, 1vw, 0.82rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .price-note strong { color: var(--text-primary); display: block; margin-bottom: 3px; }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: TRADE-OFFS
           =========================================== */
        .tradeoffs-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            align-items: start;
            overflow: hidden;
            max-height: min(73vh, 620px);
        }

        .scatter-wrapper {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .scatter-caption {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-style: italic;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .scatter-img {
            width: 100%;
            max-height: min(46vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .tradeoffs-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .summary-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: clamp(0.58rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .summary-table thead tr {
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
        }

        .summary-table thead th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: calc(var(--small-size) * 0.88);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.07em;
            padding: 5px 6px;
            text-align: left;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .summary-table thead th.right { text-align: right; }

        .summary-table tbody tr {
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
        }

        .summary-table td {
            padding: clamp(4px, 0.7vh, 8px) 6px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            vertical-align: middle;
        }

        .summary-table td.metric { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); }
        .summary-table td.right { text-align: right; }

        .prop-val { color: var(--accent-blue); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95em; }
        .ow-val   { color: var(--accent-yellow); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95em; }

        .key-finding {
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.9rem) clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: clamp(0.62rem, 1.05vw, 0.82rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .key-finding strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .takeaways-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 0% 0%, rgba(0, 217, 163, 0.08) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 100%, rgba(77, 166, 255, 0.07) 0%, transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .takeaways-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            max-height: min(70vh, 580px);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .finding-card {
            padding: clamp(0.65rem, 1.4vw, 1.2rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 6px;
            transition: border-color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .finding-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-accent); }

        .finding-card .icon-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .finding-icon {
            width: clamp(24px, 3vw, 34px);
            height: clamp(24px, 3vw, 34px);
            border-radius: 6px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .finding-icon.green  { background: rgba(0,217,163,0.15); color: var(--accent); }
        .finding-icon.red    { background: rgba(245,78,78,0.12); color: var(--accent-red); }
        .finding-icon.yellow { background: rgba(245,200,66,0.15); color: var(--accent-yellow); }
        .finding-icon.blue   { background: rgba(77,166,255,0.15); color: var(--accent-blue); }
        .finding-icon.purple { background: rgba(180,124,255,0.15); color: var(--accent-purple); }

        .finding-title {
            font-size: clamp(0.72rem, 1.2vw, 0.92rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .finding-body {
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.78rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.55;
        }

        .finding-body .hi { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 600; }

        /* Recommendation box — spans full width */
        .reco-box {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.8vw, 1.5rem);
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-radius: 10px;
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .reco-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            white-space: nowrap;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .reco-body {
            font-size: clamp(0.68rem, 1.15vw, 0.88rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.55;
        }

        .reco-body strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           FOOTER ATTRIBUTION
           =========================================== */
        .attribution {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
            right: var(--slide-padding);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: calc(var(--small-size) * 0.85);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

    </style>
</head>

        function buildIntelTable() {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('intelTableBody');

                const pct = Math.round((row.score / maxScore) * 100);
                const scoreClass = row.score >= 55 ? 'score-top' : (row.score >= 45 ? 'score-mid' : 'score-low');
                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                if (row.score >= 52) tr.classList.add('top-row');
                if (row.type === 'ow') tr.classList.add('ow-row');
                tr.innerHTML = `
